method: R1 主会话先读 text 后写（盲读，未看 md）

facts.fact: Hattie 洗碗时问 Tommy 觉得是谁；Tommy 按顺序排除 Leah
Hattie 按 Eeling 理论推断与袭击 Elle Marks 是同一人、因证人称是男人而排除 Leah
facts.anchor: “Well, if we’re going by Eeling’s theory it’s the same person who attacked Elle Marks,” she replies. “She said it was a man, so that rules out Leah.”

facts.fact: Hattie 收窄到 Dustin 和 Colm 两人
facts.anchor: “If we’re not considering Leah,” Hattie says quietly. “That leaves Dustin and Colm.”

facts.fact: Tommy 认为不是 Dustin 而是 Colm，说 Colm 一直「不一样」
facts.anchor: “No. I think it was Colm.” He sets the dish down he’s drying and faces her.

facts.fact: Tommy 列举 Colm 童年创伤：母亲伤害他、他那时在场母亲死亡
facts.anchor: He said his mom hurt him, but he never said anything about him being there when she died.

facts.fact: Tommy 说 Colm 小时候会尿床，Hattie 想起连续杀人犯特征清单里有这条
facts.anchor: I never told you Colm used to wet the bed.

facts.fact: Hattie 替 Colm 列举不在场证明：Cheryl 被杀当晚他在仓库上班、私家侦探核实打卡
facts.anchor: “Colm had an alibi for the night Cheryl was killed. He was on a shift at that warehouse job.

facts.fact: Tommy 称 Dustin 的不在场证明最弱、室友证词有漏洞
Tommy 八年来第一次叫 Hattie「Mom」
facts.anchor: “Mom.” Her gaze snaps up to his. It’s the first time she’s been called that in over eight years.

facts.fact: Hattie 回想所有深夜来电都以为是被害的 Tommy、原来全错了
facts.anchor: It still sends a chill through her to think of all the times she answered the night calls

facts.fact: Tommy 说要等事情了结后去探望父亲 Ed，Hattie 答应同去
facts.anchor: “I never . . . got to visit him. After this is over, I’d like to.”
